Presbyterian men’s basketball announces 2026-27 non-conference schedule
Presbyterian College has released its men's basketball non-conference schedule for the upcoming season. Coach Quinton Ferrell highlighted several key matchups both at home and away as preparation for conference play.
The Presbyterian Blue Hose men's basketball program announced its 2026-27 non-conference schedule on Oct. 1, featuring seven home games at the Templeton Center.
Coach Quinton Ferrell said, "We have a tremendous non-conference schedule that will definitely prepare us for Big South Conference play. It was important that we got some quality opponents to come to Templeton, and we did that with St. Thomas (MN), Mercer, Sacramento State, and Samford. We also have the opportunity to compete against NCAA tournament-caliber teams in Georgia, NC State, Butler, and Wake Forest, which was very important to me. Hopefully our non-conference schedule will get all our Blue Hose fans excited for the upcoming season!"
The team opens its season with an exhibition game at Clemson on October 28. The regular season begins at home against St. Thomas on November 2 before road games at Georgia on November 6 and NC State on November 10. Presbyterian then hosts Mercer on November 18 and travels to Tennessee Tech on November 21. The month concludes with home games against Carolina Christian (November 24) and Sacramento State (November 28).
In December, Presbyterian starts with three consecutive away games: Butler (December 2), Morehead State (December 5), and ETSU (December 8). Home contests follow against Samford (December 12) and Allen (December 15). The Blue Hose finish their non-conference road slate at Navy (December 19) and Wake Forest (December 22), concluding the schedule with a home game versus CIU on December 28.
Finalized tipoff times and television designations are expected to be announced later. Season tickets for all Blue Hose basketball home games are available.
